properties.content:

Incident Time: 2007-05-25 15:30:00
Nearest City: Dubach, LA
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: NATURAL GAS
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: MISSISSIPPI RIVER TRANSMISSION CORP.
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER STATED THERE WAS A SPILL OF MATERIALS FROM A PIPELINE THAT IS CONNECTED TO AN ENGINE AT A STORAGE FACILITY. CALLER STATED AN EMPLOYEE WAS WORKING ON AN ENGINE THAT HAD BEEN BLOWN DOWN, LOCKED OUT, AND TAGGED OUT. CALLER STATED AS THE EMPLOYEE BEGAN DIS-ASSEMBLING THE UNLOADER A PISTON BLEW OUT HITTING THE EMPLOYEE IN THE ABDOMEN. THE PISTON DID NOT PENETRATE THE EMPLOYEE BUT DID CAUSE INTERNAL INJURIES. THE EMPLOYEE WAS TAKEN TO THE HOSPITAL WHERE THREE FEET OF HIS COLON HAD TO BE REMOVED. THE EMPLOYEE WILL BE HOSPITALIZE FOR FIVE TO SEVEN DAYS. CALLER STATED THIS WAS CAUSED DUE TO THE POWER GAS TO THE HEAD END UNLOADER WHICH WAS NOT VENTED PRIOR TO DIS-ASSEMBLING THE UNLOADER. THE PISTON MAY HAVE HAD 300 POUNDS BEHIND IT WHEN IT STRUCK THE EMPLOYEE. CALLER STATED THIS WILL ALL BE PART OF THE INVESTIGATION.

Medium Affected: UNKNOWN

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 33.495150, -97.159917 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Report Description
A SOUTHBOUND FREIGHT TRAIN HAS DERAILED FOUR (4) LOCOMOTIVES AND THIRTEEN (13) RAILCARS ON A SINGLE MAIN TRACK. THE INITIAL CAUSE OF INCIDENT IS UNKNOWN, SUSPECTED TO BE WEATHER RELATED (FLOODING). TWO OF THE ENGINES ARE ON THEIR SIDES, WITH A STRONG POTENTIAL TO DISCHARGE DIESEL FUEL. THE CALLER STATED THAT THERE IS A POTENTIAL THAT SOME OF THE RAILCARS INVOLVED CONTAIN HAZMAT, HOWEVER, THIS HAS NOT BEEN CONFIRMED. FOUR CREW-MEMBERS HAVE BEEN TRANSPORTED TO DENTON REGIONAL HOSPITAL, ONLY ONE WAS TREATED FOR NON-LIFE THREATENING INJURIES. THE DERAILMENT OCCURRED ON A PASSENGER ROUTE AND DELAYS ARE EXPECTED. THE RP EXPECT THE PASSENGERS WILL BE TRANSPORTED VIA BUS BRIDGE (UNCONFIRMED). DAMAGES WILL EXCEED THE THRESHOLD; ESTIMATE UNKNOWN.

Report Description
ON 08/5/13 AT 1749 HOURS, AA TRAIN DISPATCHER REPORTED SOUTHBOUND TRAIN Q61705 WITH LOCOMOTIVES CSXT 5111 (DVR EQUIPPED) AND CSXT 250 (NO DVR) COLLIDED WITH AN OCCUPIED VEHICLE AT MILEPOST 000 642.6 ON THE M AND M SUBDIVISION. THE TRAIN STOPPED AND CREW IS WALKING BACK TO LOCATION; HOWEVER, THE TRAIN CREW ADVISED THE TRUCK CAUGHT FIRE. THIS WAS LOCATED AT PINE AND RAILROAD STREET IN BAY MINETTE, ALABAMA. BALDWIN COUNTY 911 WAS NOTIFIED AND RESPONDED. THEY REPORT SUBJECT WAS EJECTED FROM THE VEHICLE WITH SERIOUS INJURIES. UPDATE: AT 1900 HOURS, REPORTED UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF DIESEL FUEL FROM THE SEMI-TRUCK SPRAYED OVER 100 FEET ALONG THE RAILROAD TRACKS. THERE ARE NO REPORT OF WATERWAYS AFFECTED. US ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES ARE RESPONDING TO CONDUCT CLEAN UP.

properties.summary: Incident Type: PIPELINE - NRC Report ID: 904941 - Medium Affected: SUBSURFACE - Suspected Responsible Party: ENTERGY CORPORATION
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 904941
Incident Time: 2009-05-07 22:30:00
Nearest City: Redfield, AR
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: SULFURIC ACID, SPENT
Medium Affected: SUBSURFACE
Suspected Responsible Party: ENTERGY CORPORATION
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 210 gallons
UNDERGROUND WASTEWATER PIPE FAILURE WAS DISCOVERED. PIPELINE FAILED WITHIN EMBANKMENT AND BERM OF ON SITE RAILROAD DELIVERING COAL TO PLANT. PIPE PERIODICALLY CONTAINS SPENT DILUTED SULFURIC ACID WASTE FROM WATER TREATMENT PLANT CATION/ANION RESIN REGENERATION PROCESS TO FACILITY'S ON SITE NPDES PERMITTED TREATMENT SYSTEM. WASTEWATER CONTAINING DILUTED SULFURIC ACID WAS POTENTIALLY DISCHARGED FROM THE BROKEN SECTIONS OF THE PIPE DURING THE REGENERATION PROCESS AND TEMPORARILY SPILLED ONTO THE CONFINING SOILS AROUND THE PIPE AND THEN CHANNELED BACK INTO THE OTHER SECTION OF BROKEN PIPE LEADING TO THE PERMITTED TREATMENT SYSTEM. IT IS DIFFICULT TO DETERMINE HOW MUCH SPILLED WASTEWATER CONTAINING THE DILUTE ACID REMAINED OUTSIDE OF THE PIPE SECTIONS AFTER THE PROCESS WAS OVER. THIS REPORT IS BEING SUBMITTED TO ERR ON THE SIDE OF CAUTION SINCE THE ACTUAL AMOUNT RELEASED CANNOT BE ACCURATELY DETERMINED DUE TO THE LOCATION OF THE POTENTIAL RELEASE AND NEED TO STABILIZE THE RAILWAY BERM AND SHORE UP EXCAVATION OF FAILED AREAS DUE TO SAFETY CONCERNS FOR WORKERS.
